description: Connect read-only business databases so the agent can inspect approved schemas, answer questions with live SQL, and recall relevant records before a turn.
skill_summary: How to inspect and safely query connected SQL knowledge sources, distinguish live database facts from durable memory, and cite the connection, table, and row behind an answer.
note: PostgreSQL is available now. MySQL/MariaDB and SQL Server will join this same ability when their adapters are implemented. This does not configure WebAgent's own application database.

settings.label: Allow Live Queries
settings.hint: Let this agent issue read-only SELECT queries against approved tables.

settings.label: Automatic Recall
settings.hint: Search configured knowledge columns before substantive turns and inject a few cited excerpts.

settings.label: Maximum Query Rows
settings.hint: Hard result cap applied even when generated SQL omits LIMIT.
